+def catmull_rom(nodes, steps_per_segment=12):
+    """Smooth, endpoint-clamped Catmull-Rom interpolation of (u,v,pressure)."""
+    p = np.asarray(nodes, dtype=np.float64)
+    out = []
+    for i in range(len(p) - 1):
+        p0 = p[max(0, i - 1)]
+        p1 = p[i]
+        p2 = p[i + 1]
+        p3 = p[min(len(p) - 1, i + 2)]
+        for j in range(steps_per_segment):
+            t = j / steps_per_segment
+            t2, t3 = t * t, t * t * t
+            q = 0.5 * ((2 * p1) + (-p0 + p2) * t + (2*p0 - 5*p1 + 4*p2 - p3) * t2 + (-p0 + 3*p1 - 3*p2 + p3) * t3)
+            out.append(q)
+    out.append(p[-1])
+    return np.asarray(out)
+
+
+def densify(nodes, spacing_px=3.0):
+    curve = catmull_rom(nodes, 16)
+    lengths = np.linalg.norm(np.diff(curve[:, :2], axis=0), axis=1)
+    cum = np.r_[0.0, np.cumsum(lengths)]
+    n = max(2, int(math.ceil(cum[-1] / spacing_px)) + 1)
+    t = np.linspace(0, cum[-1], n)
+    return np.stack([np.interp(t, cum, curve[:, k]) for k in range(3)], axis=1)

def catmull_rom(nodes, steps_per_segment=12):
    """Smooth, endpoint-clamped Catmull-Rom interpolation of (u,v,pressure)."""
    p = np.asarray(nodes, dtype=np.float64)
    out = []
    for i in range(len(p) - 1):
        p0 = p[max(0, i - 1)]
        p1 = p[i]
        p2 = p[i + 1]
        p3 = p[min(len(p) - 1, i + 2)]
        for j in range(steps_per_segment):
            t = j / steps_per_segment
            t2, t3 = t * t, t * t * t
            q = 0.5 * ((2 * p1) + (-p0 + p2) * t + (2*p0 - 5*p1 + 4*p2 - p3) * t2 + (-p0 + 3*p1 - 3*p2 + p3) * t3)
            out.append(q)
    out.append(p[-1])
    return np.asarray(out)


def densify(nodes, spacing_px=3.0):
